parent: Original1B checkpoint, independent of prior25M/75M arms
objective: Original navigation reward only, all original network weights trainable; no angle/ring target, decoder loss or hand-written action controller during free navigation
unchanged: Square geometry, uniform goals, original maps/RGB renderer, goal radius/reward, six motor actions, native saved-goal code, CNN/LSTM256/actor/critic architecture

timing.endpoint_glimpse: First input of delay block, not an extra update
timing.delay_action: Constant left, action0; previous action always records actually applied action
timing.brakes: Zero vf/vs/vr at first blind turn, immediately before forward probe, and after probe before first delay action
timing.interrupts: Actual reward interrupts any event, refreshes native saved goal and returns to visible waiting; done clears saved goal/known state
timing.admission: After first reward, at most1 event per160-update BPTT segment and8/90s episode; require129 updates left in both segment and episode; ordinary native visible navigation while waiting; recurrent state persists across segments
timing.schedule_rng: Private per-slot per-episode8-event banks, event-index paired across evaluation branches; two independent turn labels/durations and one delay quantile

inputs.blind_current: Ordinary position-only512-slot snapshot held from first blind turn, updated at actual endpoint of fourth forward action; one native endpoint pulse during first delay input
inputs.native_goal: Continuous native512-slot snapshot of actual last goal pickup, including predictive component
inputs.preserved: Actual previous action and clipped reward; physical motor noise, walls and goal respawn

learning.credit_window_reason: Complete worst-case129-update event stays within one differentiable recurrent unroll
learning.forced_actions: Mask policy-gradient AND entropy on forced turns/probe/delay; train critic normally; retain recurrent gradients through forced steps
learning.optimizer: New original RMSProp,200zero-LR accumulator warmup, then original learning rate; no resumed optimizer

noise.timing: Independent additive h/c Gaussian after LSTM before actor/critic only on actual black-input updates
noise.replay: Store and replay identical eps through BPTT; separate bootstrap draw; noise RNG saved
noise.tuning: Fixed0.02 absolute units, no outcome-based tuning

evaluation.endpoints: Before warmup and after every fixed stage; retain all four stages and final
evaluation.continuous_vision: Restore RGB only; preserve forced actions, held ordinary snapshots and pulse/reset intervention
evaluation.cue_control: Replace only169 predictive current slots by ordinary values, or rotate actual endpoint travel direction/velocity by+60/-60degrees; saved goal unchanged; Grid controls exact identities
evaluation.resets: Reset after processing endpoint glimpse, before next input; or before every scheduled blind input. Matching resets in continuously visible controls
evaluation.metrics: Whole-episode score and per-event free-window hits/progress/path/updates; forced hits/walls; admission/wait/cap/interruption/full-window coverage counts; actual probe speed/displacement/travel-versus-heading/wall contacts and all three pre/post brakes, with no outcome-based exclusion
evaluation.pairing: Shared slot/episode/event plans and physics/action draws; actual outcome-driven later window onset may differ
evaluation.reset_scope: h/c carryover only; actual previous actions/rewards, external saved goal and spatial snapshot, and physical history remain

interpretation: Prospective same-agent reward-trained memory mechanism under a newly necessary blind reorientation task; not retrospective proof of a ring in original1B agents. Positive behavioral memory and PGC effects motivate fixed full-state geometry/causal stabilization tests.
selection: Prespecified fixed frame budgets, no stage selection or adaptive stopping for positive results

budget.launch: Separate explicit root authorization after source tests, independent review and frozen protocol
